messages:
alex: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR to clarify the SLA matrix timing buckets and add concrete fallback examples for Dedicated capacity. Need a quick review from eng and docs before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4282

maria: pinged. I'll skim the SLA wording. Which page did you edit?

alex: edited docs/dedicated/sla-matrix.md and added a new examples section at the bottom. Also added a small YAML sample for fallback policy.

sam: can you paste the YAML here? quick sanity check. :eyes:

alex: sure — here's the snippet I added:

```yaml
fallback_policy:
  - name: region-fallback
    match: latency > 150ms
    action:
      - route_to: dedicated-europe-fallback
      - throttle: 10rps
      - degrade_model: gpt-medium-quant
```

jin: minor nit: replace "latency > 150ms" with "p99_latency_ms > 150" — metrics naming consistency. also add a comment about what "degrade_model" does.

alex: good catch. I'll change the metric name. adding a one-line explanation for degrade_model.

harry: from eng runtime side — make sure the example includes an explicit compatibility check step. i.e. route only if the fallback model supports requested features (tool-calls, structured outputs). Otherwise it can break prod.

alex: yep adding a compatibility check example. maybe like: `if fallback_model.supports(tool_calls) == false then skip_route` — do we want that exact pseudo-code?

maria: keep it high level in docs, but include the pseudo-code as an inline note. docs team prefers actionable prose + a tiny snippet.

sam: also add a short test checklist under the example: 1) metric trigger simulated 2) verify KV cache warm/hit 3) validate function-call behavior on fallback 4) observe telemetry labels.

alex: adding checklist now. I'll push an update to the PR in a few mins.

docs-bot: Automated link-check passed for modified files. 3 external links flagged as redirects.

alex: @maria @sam @jin @harry — if you can approve or leave quick comments before EOD I'll merge tomorrow morning. If anything is contentious we can split the fallback examples into a separate PR.

maria: will review and approve by EOD. :thumbsup:

sam: lgtm assuming we follow the metric name change and add the test checklist.

jin: quick wording tweak suggestion left in PR. otherwise ok.

harry: added a comment about compatibility check, but not blocking.

alex: thanks all. I'll update PR and mark as ready for merge.
